notes: Modified cash basis for governmental funds (basis recorded as cash); business-type activities are accrual. Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p5); beginning/ending cash = beginning/ending fund balances (460,590 / 508,583, p5) since the roll-forward uses fund balance; the balance sheet p4 shows cash 508,312 with a (271) payroll withholding liability. Business-type lines are from the Total column of the proprietary revenues/expenses statement (p7). No single printed business-type total, so receipts = operating revenues 867,973 + interest income 22,737 + grants 1,345,113 and disbursements = operating expenses 678,660 + interest expense 3,700; roll-forward 3,378,666 + 2,235,823 - 682,360 + transfers 1,562 = 4,933,691. Transfer out of General 1,562 matches Gas Fund transfer in 1,562 (p7, p8). Balance sheet (attempt 2, user rule 2026-10-27): governmental lines from the governmental funds Balance Sheet - Modified Cash Basis, Total Governmental Funds column (p4: assets 508,312, liabilities (271), fund balances 508,583 by classification), whose totals equal the government-wide Governmental Activities column (p1); business-type lines and the printed totals from the Statement of Net Position (p1). Assigned for budgetary stabilization is printed as '-' and not recorded. Proprietary cash flow statement (p8) not recorded because proprietary is GAAP-only; it shows total ending cash 991,083. General Fund detail uses the department combining statement (pp12-13, more detailed); the General Fund budget schedule (p10) is not repeated, to avoid double counting. Function mapping follows the statement's functions so detail ties: Sanitation is under Public works (streets/highways), Cemetery is under Environment and leisure (culture/recreation). Combining statement p48 spans trimmed pages 12-13. Proprietary fund columns (Gas/Water/Sewer) not recorded in detail since they are the basic statement. Street fund transfer-in budget 50,000 had no actual. Trimmed p9 (v8 re-trim, report p23) is the proprietary cash flow reconciliation (operating income to net cash from operations 322,447), nothing new. Read pages 1-13 of 13
